checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: add Gates 2011 and Li 2025 as context and a no-dementia-prevention/no-diagnostic claim boundary on Evidence

impact_assessment.benefits: Closes a claim-boundary gap and documents the difference between validated screening and a consumer focus-test app.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Verify via efetch, add records and references, update counts, add failing-first UI tests, run suites and review UI.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: two context records and two new UI citations; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: counts and references must move together
impact_assessment.why: The Evidence screen lists many claim boundaries but none for dementia prevention or diagnosis, despite two verified residual reviews addressing exactly those distinctions.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: extend citation-grounding to every UI source file so any hardcoded PMID must resolve to the corpus

impact_assessment.benefits: Turns a one-screen check into a project-wide invariant over all 75 in-app citations.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use the same PMID regex and allowlist, add the assertion, run the suite and confirm all UI sources resolve.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: test-only change to one file using existing corpus; dependency: node fs/path only; concurrency: none; state: no app or evidence-count changes
impact_assessment.why: The grounding test only scanned EvidenceScreen; hardcoded citations in Home, Settings, Results, Menu and other panels could drift without detection.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: update the stale EVIDENCE_REVIEW_VERSION constant to v2.37 and add a docs-vs-app drift guard

impact_assessment.benefits: Exports and UI report the correct review revision; a guard test prevents future drift.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Update the constant and pinned regex, add a test comparing it to the docs status line, run suites and verify the Settings label in Edge.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: one metadata constant, one pinned test and one new guard test; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no evidence-count changes
impact_assessment.why: Research exports and the Settings screen still label the corpus v1.8 (2026-11-08) while the review is v2.37, mislabelling exported data.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: add committed browser proof scripts for Digit Span gameplay and its within-level trend, matching the other ten games

impact_assessment.benefits: Repeatable gameplay and trend proofs with screenshots, consistent with the project's dogfooding practice.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Adapt the spatial proofs, verify the forward/backward answer logic, run both proofs against a built app, then commit.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: two new scripts under scripts/, regenerated codebase map; dependency: playwright-core and a local server; concurrency: none; state: no app or evidence changes
impact_assessment.why: Every other game has a committed dogfood proof script; Digit Span was verified only with throwaway scripts, leaving the convention incomplete.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: wire keyboard number keys for Digit Span (0-9) and Symbol (1-4) in SessionScreen

impact_assessment.mitigation: Add branches matching each mechanic's advertised controls, add jsdom key tests, run suites and verify keys in Edge.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: one keydown handler and failing-first UI tests; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no evidence-count changes
